query:
UPDATE core.contracts c
             SET checklist_done_at = CASE
                   WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM core.contract_checklists cl
                                    WHERE cl.contract_id = c.id AND cl.checked_at IS NULL)
                   THEN coalesce(c.checklist_done_at, core.now())
                 END
             WHERE c.id = $1
